subject: pharmacology
title: Niacin, Resins, PCSK9 Inhibitors, Bempedoic Acid and Omega 3 Fats

steps.tx: Nicotinic acid (niacin) at gram doses inhibits hormone sensitive lipase in adipose tissue, cutting free fatty acid flux to the liver so VLDL (very low density lipoprotein) assembly falls, triglycerides drop and HDL rises more than with any other oral agent. Outcome trials added to statins, however, showed no event benefit, leaving **niacin** a historical and examination drug whose adverse effect, flushing, remains the most tested in this corner of pharmacology.
steps.say: Niacin moves every lipid number the right way and still failed outcome trials; know it for its flushing.

left.title: Niacin lipid effects
points: Adipose lipolysis inhibited, fatty acid flux falls
Triglycerides down 20 to 50 percent
HDL raised 15 to 35 percent, best in class
LDL down modestly, lipoprotein(a) reduced

right.title: Why niacin faded
points: No outcome benefit added to statins in AIM HIGH and HPS2 THRIVE
Flushing, itch and gastrointestinal upset burden adherence
Hyperglycaemia, gout and liver enzyme rises
Survives in examinations and rare specialist niches

steps.tx: **Niacin flushing** is prostaglandin D2 and E2 mediated cutaneous vasodilatation: burning redness of face and trunk within minutes of a dose, worst in the first weeks before tachyphylaxis mercifully develops. Aspirin 30 minutes beforehand blocks the prostaglandin surge, slow dose escalation and bedtime dosing with a low fat snack blunt it further, and laropiprant, a prostaglandin receptor blocker once co formulated for exactly this, was withdrawn when its parent trial disappointed.
steps.say: Flushing is prostaglandins, aspirin beforehand is the antidote, and tolerance arrives if patients persist.

nodes.label: Skin prostaglandin D2 and E2 release
Burning facial flushing and itch within minutes
Aspirin pre dose blocks the prostaglandin surge

steps.tx: Bile acid sequestrants **cholestyramine** and colesevelam are non absorbed resins that bind bile acids in the gut, forcing the liver to burn cholesterol making replacements and upregulating LDL receptors for a 15 to 25 percent LDL fall. Cholestyramine's gritty powder, bloating and constipation limit it; colesevelam's tablets are kinder and even improve glycaemia. Both bind co administered drugs and fat soluble vitamins, so other medicines are spaced one hour before or four hours after.
steps.say: Resins trap bile in the gut and make the liver spend cholesterol replacing it; space every other drug around them.

left.title: Cholestyramine
points: Powder resin, gritty and constipating
LDL down 15 to 25 percent at full doses
Also treats bile acid diarrhoea and pruritus
Binds warfarin, thyroxine and many others

right.title: Colesevelam
points: Tablet resin, better tolerated
Modest glycaemic improvement in type 2 diabetes
Fewer drug interactions but spacing still advised
Triglycerides can rise; avoid in severe hypertriglyceridaemia

steps.tx: The protein PCSK9 normally escorts hepatic LDL receptors to lysosomal destruction; monoclonal antibodies **evolocumab** and alirocumab neutralise it, receptors recycle to the surface repeatedly, and LDL falls by 50 to 60 percent on top of statins. Fortnightly or monthly self injections, outcome benefit in FOURIER and ODYSSEY, and a clean adverse profile except injection site reactions make cost, not pharmacology, the barrier. Inclisiran, a small interfering RNA dosed twice yearly, silences PCSK9 production upstream.
steps.say: PCSK9 antibodies let LDL receptors live longer and work harder; sixty percent more lowering, priced accordingly.

vis.alt: Lipoprotein metabolism and atherogenesis pathways diagram
vis.caption: Lipoprotein metabolism pathways within which PCSK9 inhibition preserves hepatic LDL receptor recycling.

steps.tx: **Bempedoic acid** inhibits ATP citrate lyase two steps above HMG CoA reductase in the same synthesis pathway, but it is a prodrug activated only by a liver enzyme absent from skeletal muscle, which is its entire commercial logic: statin pathway benefit without muscle exposure. LDL falls about 18 percent alone and more with ezetimibe in a fixed combination. Costs are a small gout signal from raised uric acid, cholelithiasis reports and a tendon rupture caution shared oddly with fluoroquinolone co therapy.
steps.say: Bempedoic acid blocks cholesterol synthesis only where the liver activates it, sparing muscle by design.

nodes.label: Bempedoic acid prodrug reaches the liver
Hepatic enzyme activates it; ATP citrate lyase blocked
Muscle lacks the activating enzyme and is spared
LDL receptors rise, LDL falls about 18 percent

steps.tx: Prescription **omega 3 fatty acids** divide by formulation: mixed EPA DHA (eicosapentaenoic and docosahexaenoic acid) preparations lower triglycerides at 4 g daily with a small LDL rise from the DHA component, while purified EPA ethyl ester, icosapent ethyl, cut events in the REDUCE IT trial in statin treated patients with raised triglycerides. Atrial fibrillation and bleeding signals accompany high dose therapy, and over the counter fish oil capsules contain a fraction of trial doses.
steps.say: Four grams is a drug dose: icosapent ethyl has outcome data, supermarket fish oil does not.

left.title: Icosapent ethyl (purified EPA)
points: 2 g twice daily on top of statin therapy
REDUCE IT: fewer cardiovascular events
Small atrial fibrillation and bleeding excess
No LDL rise, unlike mixed preparations

right.title: Mixed EPA DHA products
points: Triglycerides fall at prescription doses
DHA component can raise LDL cholesterol
Outcome trials neutral for events
Over the counter doses far below trial doses

steps.tx: **Severe hypertriglyceridaemia** above 10 mmol per litre (about 880 mg per dl) is treated to prevent pancreatitis rather than atherosclerosis, and the order of operations matters: alcohol abstinence, glycaemic control, stopping culprits like oestrogens and isotretinoin, then fibrates or prescription omega 3, with statins contributing modestly. In the acute pancreatitis of hypertriglyceridaemia, insulin infusions activate lipoprotein lipase and plasmapheresis enters specialist conversations when levels are extreme.
steps.say: Triglycerides over ten are a pancreatitis problem: remove causes first, then fibrate or omega 3.

nodes.label: Triglycerides above 10 mmol per litre confirmed
Alcohol, diabetes control and culprit drugs addressed
Goal below 5.6 mmol per litre to protect the pancreas

steps.tx: **Combination logic** for LDL assembles the lesson set in order of evidence and tolerability: maximally tolerated statin first, ezetimibe second, PCSK9 therapy third for high risk patients still above target, with bempedoic acid for the statin intolerant and resins as a non systemic extra. Each layer multiplies rather than replaces, so a patient can plausibly stack an 85 percent total LDL reduction without any single drug at a heroic dose.
steps.say: Statin, then ezetimibe, then PCSK9; stack percentages instead of hero doses.

left.title: Combination sequence
points: Maximally tolerated statin as the foundation
Add ezetimibe for the next 15 to 20 percent
Add PCSK9 therapy in high risk patients above target
Bempedoic acid where statin intolerance limits dosing

right.title: Stacked effect
points: Each layer multiplies the previous reduction
Total LDL falls of 80 percent or more are achievable
No single drug pushed to a heroic dose
Adherence reviewed at every layer before escalating
